name: opencode-hook-plugins
description: hook-logger + llm-review-gate opencode plugins, packed and installed locally by extracting this tarball straight into opencode's own package cache under a bare name@version (no registry, no server - see CLAUDE.md). Written in TypeScript against @opencode-ai/plugin's Plugin type. After editing any source file here, run `npm pack` in this directory to regenerate the committed opencode-hook-plugins-1.0.0.tgz - tests/unit/plugins-tarball.test.mjs fails if the tarball and source drift apart.
